nodes.name: Every minute
nodes.notes: Schedule trigger. Runs once a minute while the workflow is active.

parameters.query:
SELECT m.owner_id, m.daily_cap, coalesce(b.spent_today, 0) AS spent_today, g.id AS guardian_id,
  count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.status = 'rejected') AS rejected_5m,
  coalesce(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE c.method = 'fund_job' AND c.status = 'success'), 0) AS funded_5m,
  count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.method = 'fund_job' AND c.status = 'success'
                      AND coalesce(r.settled_jobs, 0) < 3) AS new_seller_funds_5m
FROM mandates m
JOIN agents g ON g.owner_id = m.owner_id AND g.role = 'guardian' AND g.status = 'active'
JOIN profiles p ON p.id = m.owner_id
LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.account_id = p.near_account_id
LEFT JOIN chain_txs c ON c.owner_id = m.owner_id
      AND c.created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND c.method <> 'pause'
LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = c.job_id
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = j.seller_id
LEFT JOIN reputation r ON r.account_id = s.near_account_id
WHERE m.paused = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guardian_alerts ga
                   WHERE ga.owner_id = m.owner_id AND ga.resolved_at IS NULL
                     AND ga.created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes')
GROUP BY m.owner_id, m.daily_cap, b.spent_today, g.id;

nodes.name: Activity last 5 min
nodes.notes: Per owner with an active guardian: refused calls, USDC funded, funds to new sellers in the last 5 minutes. Skips owners already paused or alerted in the last 30 minutes.

nodes.name: Rules
nodes.notes: Paper III.d: 3+ refused calls, spending at 90% of the daily cap, or 3+ jobs to new sellers. Returns nothing when all is fine (the run stops).

nodes.name: Pause args
nodes.notes: Builds a pause call for the guardian's pause-only key.

nodes.name: Chain call
nodes.notes: Calls lib chain-call, the only door to NEAR. Mock mode checks the mandate in the database; testnet mode signs with the right limited key.

nodes.name: Save alert
nodes.notes: Inserts guardian_alerts with the reasons and the pause transaction.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Feed message: 'Paused your agents: ... Only you can unpause.'

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
